description: A Spatio-Temporal Dataset of Urban Water Distribution Schedules in Tegucigalpa (2016–2025) v1.2 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Yanira Rivera. Urban Water Distribution Schedules Dataset for Tegucigalpa, Honduras (2016–2025) This dataset provides a harmonized spatio-temporal reconstruction of urban water distribution schedules for Tegucigalpa (2016–2025), derived from monthly calendars published by the municipal utility (UMAPS/SANAA). It captures neighborhood-level variation in intermittent water supply as days with piped water per month. Coverage: national (HN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
